title: Writ field merge rule declarations (v1)
description: Declarative field merge rule declarations: strategies, keys, lattices, and value types per (op_type, field) tuple. Normative text: spec/fold.md (merge strategies) and spec/value-types.md (value types). additionalProperties is deliberately never false: unknown fields are preserved and ignored.

op_type.description: Operation type to which this rule applies.

op_version.description: Operation version to which this rule applies.

field.description: Name of the field in the operation body. Shares schema-ops.schema.json's field_name grammar (spec/schema-ops.md §4.3).

target.description: State key in the generic fold map (ObjectState.State). Defaults to field if omitted. Shares schema-ops.schema.json's target_name grammar (spec/schema-ops.md §4.3): TargetKey() returns this or field interchangeably, and a projection turns either into a generated SQL identifier.

strategy.description: Closed catalogue merge strategy from spec/fold.md.

key.description: Ordered list of key components for keyed-lww strategy. Each column shares schema-ops.schema.json's key_column_name grammar (spec/schema-ops.md §4.3).

lattice.description: Ordered elements of the semilattice for lattice strategy.

value_type.description: Closed catalogue value type from spec/value-types.md, for the strategy's register or element. Optional: a rule declaring none is untyped (spec/value-types.md), the same no-implicit-behavior idiom spec/fold.md §5 states for an undeclared strategy.

enum.description: The value list for value_type "enum". Required iff value_type is "enum", forbidden otherwise.

max_length.description: Maximum length in Unicode code points, for value_type "string" or "text" only.

key_types.description: Key column name to value type, for strategy "keyed-lww" only. Must cover exactly the columns key declares.
